shadows.name: ambient
shadows.purpose: Rare elevation; prefer 1px borders at rest.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Filled commitment CTA with AA white-on-fill contrast.
components.css: .primary { background: var(--brand-action); color: var(--brand-on); min-height: 44px; border-radius: 12px; font-weight: 700; }

narrative.overview: Operate-mode property product: light zinc surfaces, one orange action voice, flat border-led elevation, mobile-first 44px targets.
keyCharacteristics: Zinc neutrals + single orange commitment color

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Orange for commitment actions and brand marks only.

rules.name: The Contrast Rule
rules.body: Body text ≥4.5:1; CTAs use brand-fill with brand-on.

rules.name: The Border-First Rule
rules.body: Prefer 1px borders over soft shadows at rest.

dos: Do use brand-fill for filled CTAs with white labels.
Do keep interactive targets ≥44×44 on mobile chrome.
donts: Don't use vivid brand orange as small body text on white.
Don't stack soft shadow + thick border on resting cards.
